Name: CR Number
Description: Case Registration Number (facility MRN, replaces OpenMRS ID as the primary patient identifier). Format target: FacilityPrefix/8-digit sequential; date segment deferred to hisp_india_core custom identifier source; interim = HISPI prefix + 8-digit sequential.
Format description: HISPI + 8-digit sequential number (e.g. HISPI00000001). Prefix admin-editable in Manage Identifier Sources.

Name: Aadhaar Number
Description: Aadhaar number (UIDAI). Optional - not every patient has one, visible by default on the registration form.
Format description: 12-digit Aadhaar number, no spaces or dashes

Name: ABHA Number
Description: ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) number. Optional - hidden behind Configure identifiers overlay until ABDM integration is built.
